messages:
Ana (PM): Quick run-through before we flip the GA switch for predictor-v2. Need explicit owners for: SLA text + fallback, runbook + rollback, week-1 oncall plan, alert thresholds + dashboards, pricing promo & reserved path, and any contract carve-outs. Minimal thread pls.

Ben (SRE): SLA draft: 99.95% monthly uptime, p95 <= 110ms, p99 <= 350ms (typical). Operational fallback rule: if request_queue_time > 250ms for 3m OR model_error_rate > 0.75% for 5m -> route to cheap-fallback-model and page SRE. I'll own infra items and fallback config.

Rhea (Docs): API quickstart & examples done. Open: runbook (escalation ladder + rollback CLI) and a 1-pager "how to triage prompt regressions". Will finish runbook when Ben confirms the exact failover CLI. PR created: https://git.repo/PR/912.

Omar (Sales): Sales asks for a launch promo: 10% off first 60 days for up to 30 named accounts; Finance tentatively OK with a $ cap. Need Product + Finance signoff and billing SKU. I'll draft email & customer list template.

Tess (Finance): Fine with promo if exposure < $YYK and we tag it to promo billing SKU PROMO-GA-2026. Also need reserved-pricing term sheet for enterprise path (Sales + Finance to own).

Mei (Support): Support readiness: need runbook links in the internal portal, CS oncall handoff for week-1, and sample escalations. Suggest adding a short triage checklist to the runbook: "is it latency, errors, or prompt drift?"

Legal-bot: Reminder: any SLA exceptions (eg HIPAA customer X) require a signed addendum + DPA. Legal will not approve oral commitments. See template: https://contracts.corp/addendum-template.

Ops-bot: Nightly canary smoke scheduled 02:00 UTC against canary cluster. Results to post in #eng-sre and to rollout dashboard.

Ben (SRE): Runbook excerpt to include (for Rhea):
```
# when p99 > SLA or error spike
1) Pin traffic to last-known-good model: `rwctl pin --model v2.1-stable`
2) Scale GPU pool: `infra scale predictor-gpu --count +2`
3) If unresolved after 15m -> enable fallback route: `rwctl route --to fallback-small` and page oncall
```

Rhea (Docs): Added the CLI snippets into PR/912. Will add the triage checklist and publish once Ben confirms wording. ETA: tomorrow AM.

Omar (Sales): Two asks: 1) confirm reserved-pricing offer (term + process) for enterprise; 2) need product-approved promo copy and billing code. I'll own both.

Tess (Finance): I'll co-own reserved-pricing rubric with Omar. Will also confirm promo cap and edit billing SKU.

Mei (Support): I'll arrange CS oncall handoff and add support contacts to the runbook. Need final runbook link to publish to portal.

Ana (PM): Owners recap: SLA & infra -> Ben; Docs/runbook -> Rhea; Sales/promo & reserved path -> Omar + Tess; Support handoff -> Mei; Legal addendum -> Legal-bot. I'll maintain the final checklist and call Ready when every owner posts "green" in this thread. Any final blockers? :rocket:

Ben (SRE): One last blocker: confirm SRE + CS oncall overlap for first 72 hours. I recommend adding an extra SRE on rotation day 0-3.

Mei (Support): Agree. CS will piggyback onpager for high-severity incidents and have a standby rep for week-1.

Ana (PM): OK. I've added "SRE extra coverage day 0-3" and "CS standby rep" to checklist. I'll publish the checklist doc in 30m. If you can reply with green when your item is done, I'll flip GA. :thumbsup:
